item.title: Senate Grills Accountant-General Over N28tn Revenue, Zero Capital Allocations
item.description: Lawmakers question Accountant-General of the Federation over unpaid contracts and demand explanation for N28tn revenue amid stalled 2025 capital releases.

item.title: CIBN, Bank CEOs Meet IGP To Bolster Security Of Financial System
item.description: CIBN and bank CEOs meet IGP to strengthen intelligence-led protection of Nigeria’s financial institutions.

item.title: Army Arrests Suspect for Allegedly Impersonating Retired Major General
item.description: Army arrests suspect accused of falsely claiming retired Major General rank and national honours.

item.title: Four Sentenced To Death By Hanging For Killing Rivers DPO
item.description: Rivers High Court sentences four to death by hanging over 2023 killing of Ahoada East DPO SP Bako Angbashim.

item.title: World Bank, Access Bank CEO Say Recapitalisation Will Boost Private Sector Credit
item.description: World Bank director Verghis and Access Bank CEO Ogbonna predict recapitalised banks will increase lending, strengthen liquidity, and drive economic growth across Nigeria.

item.title: Kim Jong Un Names Kim Ju Ae, His Daughter As Heir Apparent, South Korean Intelligence Reports
item.description: South Korea’s spy agency says Kim Jong Un has designated teenage daughter Kim Ju Ae as official successor.

item.title: FRSC Fires 43 Officers Over Desertion, Misconduct, Scandalous Behaviour
item.description: FRSC dismisses 31 for desertion, 5 for scandalous acts, 7 for patrol misconduct, reinforcing zero-tolerance policy.

item.title: United Nigeria Airlines To Launch Direct Lagos–New York Flight Mid-2026
item.description: United Nigeria Airlines will commence direct flights from Lagos to New York by mid-2026, to mark its fifth anniversary.

item.title: Gombe Signs MoUs With Tunisian Consortium To Drive Infrastructure And Energy Projects
item.description: Gombe Signs MoUs With Tunisian consortium for joint projects in water, renewable energy, transport, and urban development to boost Gombe’s economy.

item.title: Trump Repeals Obama-Era Finding That Greenhouse Gases Threaten Public Health
item.description: Donald Trump overturns 2009 greenhouse gas ruling, triggering legal battles and reshaping US climate regulation nationwide.
